name: LONGVIEW — Long-Horizon Session Synthesis
description: Map-reduce months of agent sessions (memo-ray entity store) into a workspace knowledge graph and cited deliverables (report, PRD, skill, book, TOGAF prep) on the local model. Phases are bounded; the per-session fan-out lives inside the map phase's checkpointed loop, never as manifest tasks (ADR-005 §4). Execute via `benny longview run` or `node scripts/longview/longview.mjs run`.

phases.description: memo-ray sync + session census (deterministic, no LLM)
One gated session card per session via the local model; ledgered and resume-safe. limit 0 = whole backlog.
Deterministic rollups + /rag/ingest with deep_synthesis so cards become graph Documents/Concepts, not just vectors
Code graph: junction the repo into src/, Tree-Sitter scan → code graph → CORRELATES_WITH links to knowledge concepts (reuses benny enrich)
Discovery loops: under-explored questions → retrieval (chunks + graph) → cited discovery notes → re-ingested so each loop and every deliverable stands on a richer corpus

Graph enrichment: persist embeddings, canonical-merge near-duplicate concepts (merge_count sizing), cross-document similarity links, typed rel_class, re-cluster into named themes (reuses benny enrich-graph)
Post-graph session review: for each session, collate its contribution against the concept graph + cross-session links into data_out/reviews/<sid>.md (the 'greater than the sum' pass)
Dossiers → themes → report/PRD/skill/book + TOGAF SAD run instructions (bounded calls, citations kept, discovery notes woven in)
The AI Vampire: hierarchical outline (parts→chapters→sections) then ~100 retrieval-grounded cited sections assembled into a 200+ page book (resume-safe per section)
Assembled book → print-styled HTML → PDF via headless Edge/Chrome

outputs.state: longview/ (inventory, evidence, cards, rollups, ledger.jsonl, status.json)
outputs.deliverables: data_out/ (PORTFOLIO-REPORT.md, PRD-WHAT-COMES-NEXT.md, THEMES.md, dossiers/, skills/, book/, TOGAF-RUN.md)

metadata.delta_mode: benny longview run --delta — maps only new/changed sessions; reduce reruns at delta_reduce_threshold new cards
